add.text: Art. 3 Abs. 1 lit. a i.V.m. Art. 5 lit. a HKÜ
add.label: STATUTE

comment: HKÜ (SR 0.211.230.02) is a ratified treaty: STATUTE. BG-KKE is a federal act: STATUTE, span extended over -KKE. Outcome: the whole proceeding is a Fristwiederherstellungsgesuch forwarded to the court; item 1 (nicht eingetreten) is the only ruling, so inadmissible, although the batch-3 clarification calls such a request a side request.
